characters.description: Ilea's covert investigator ally from earlier books. She vanished during her inquiry into the Golden Lily, which remains unresolved.
characters.name: Eve

characters.description: The confirmed cause of an earlier demon crisis. He is absent from the current action, while his motive, destination, and possible ties to ancient systems remain unknown.
characters.name: Adam Strand

characters.description: An Azarinth Sentinel and explorer leaving the North with a Taleen Gate Key that may help her search for Kyrian. She is traveling toward Tremor's vaults before returning south.
characters.name: Ilea Spears

characters.description: An ancient necromancer traveling with Ilea and a dwarven expedition companion toward Tremor’s vaults.
characters.name: Ancient necromancer-king

characters.description: A dwarven member of the expedition traveling with Ilea and an ancient necromancer toward Tremor’s vaults.
characters.name: Dwarven expedition companion

characters.description: A Serethil hunter, translator, and curse mage working with northern allies against Taleen machines. Ilea entrusts him with a Taleen diary while he helps investigate ancient ruins and facilities.
characters.name: Niivalyr

characters.description: The name used for Niivalyr, the Serethil hunter who translates the Taleen diary and marks Ilea's new armor to identify her as an ally of the hunters.
characters.name: Elfie

characters.description: The former queen of Tremor, now committed to Hallowfort and its civic work rather than restoring her lost realm. She remains in the North while the former king travels south.
characters.name: Ancient queen

characters.description: Ilea's trusted Ravenhall associate and the intended recipient of most resources recovered from Tremor's vault.
characters.name: Claire

characters.description: Someone Ilea plans to find once she returns to the south.
characters.name: Kayla

characters.description: The former guard captain of Tremor. A report that he returned from the Soul Ripper dungeon before apparently dying prompts an investigation by the ancient king.
characters.name: Former guard captain

characters.description: An awakened smith working with the Serethil hunters and a dwarven expedition companion at a Taleen facility.
characters.name: Awakened smith

characters.description: A Hallowfort council member and leader of its hunter's den. After earlier attacks on the settlement, she gives Ilea an enchanted sphere reserved for an absolute emergency.
characters.name: Catelyn

characters.description: A sentient enchanted dagger.
characters.name: Aki

characters.description: A young realm traveler from Earth whose magical paintings can find people she has met. Her uncertain images of Kyrian show him alive, trapped somewhere unfamiliar, and still fighting.
characters.name: Cless

characters.description: Ilea's missing companion and the intended object of her search using the recovered Taleen Gate Key.
characters.name: Kyrian

characters.description: Ilea's lightning-mage ally, living with the surviving members of his household while recovering from profound loss. He no longer sees greater combat power as a sufficient purpose for his life.
characters.name: Trian

characters.description: A Shadow’s Hand fire mage who fought at Riverwatch and during Ravenhall’s retaking. He recognizes Ilea during her resistance training and tests her with powerful fire magic.
characters.name: Viper

characters.description: A Shadow’s Hand ranger whose trauma after losing part of his team has kept him from fighting effectively. In a supervised bout with Ilea, he uses exceptionally dangerous cursed arrows and regains some confidence.
characters.name: Philip

characters.description: An enchanter whose runesight is central to the attempt to move Aki into a Taleen Guardian. She studies complex runic systems and supports Ravenhall's research into ancient machinery.
characters.name: Iana

characters.description: The organizer leading Ravenhall's plan to become a council-governed, self-ruling territory. He seeks negotiated independence and brings Ilea into the proposed civic structure.
characters.name: Dagon

characters.description: A librarian, Dagon's wife, and supporter of Ravenhall's independence project. Ilea gives her and Dagon northern historical material connected to several unresolved investigations.
characters.name: Elise

characters.description: A Riverwatch guard captain and trusted ally of Ilea. He sends a delayed request asking her to assess increased monster activity in the western forest and possible cooperation with Ravenhall.
characters.name: Dale

characters.description: A Riverwatch governor candidate trusted by Dale.
characters.name: Alistair Gallion

characters.description: An elder of the Sanctuary Healing Order who knows the concealed routes beneath Stormbreach and offers to guide Ilea into the occupied city.
characters.name: Collin Rey

characters.description: Stormbreach's weakened blood-spirit patron and leader of the Sanctuary Healing Order. Grieving the city's transformed citizens, she joins Ilea in a plan to overthrow its occupiers.
characters.name: Lady of Benevolence

characters.description: The demon ruling occupied Stormbreach, previously encountered after escaping Ravenhall. Ilea kills it and frees the city from its immediate control.
characters.name: Frenzy King

characters.description: A dark sorcerer and leading member of the Vulture's Brotherhood who provides refuge to unusual allies.
characters.name: Walter

characters.description: A telepathic demon allied with Ilea and living safely among the Vulture's Brotherhood. He is teaching an apprentice while relying on the secluded group for protection and acceptance.
characters.name: Weavy

characters.description: Weavy’s apprentice, making progress under the telepathic demon’s unconventional teaching.
characters.name: Hein

characters.description: A reclusive blood-drinking mage accused of a refugee's murder in Riverwatch. He denies the charge, says he pays willing blood donors, and joins Ilea to determine who is framing him.
characters.name: Kevin

characters.description: The teenage foster daughter of a murdered investigator. After Ilea heals her younger foster brother, Vin provides the warehouse lead behind a dangerous Riverwatch smuggling inquiry.
characters.name: Vin

characters.description: A Gray Company co-owner and ash mage who oversees an underground holding site. Ilea encounters him while posing as a powerful buyer to protect the captives and learn how the operation works.
characters.name: Mason

characters.description: A cursed Serethil hunter who accepts Ilea's offer to spar.
characters.name: Red-scaled hunter

characters.description: An ice mage among the cursed Serethil hunters seeking Taleen machines, active gates, and allies. His prior visits to human cities give him unusual knowledge of human society.
characters.name: Ben

characters.description: A powerful fire mage fighting the corruption outbreak in the Descent's first layer. Ilea heals her before they work together to establish a defensible perimeter.
characters.name: Fire fox

characters.description: A four-armed shadow warrior who reports additional breaches and supports concentrating the first-layer defense.
characters.name: Four-armed shadow warrior

characters.description: The four-armed defender who identifies himself as guardian of the Descent's first lair after its defenders establish a stronger position.
characters.name: First Layer Guardian

characters.description: A noncombatant support specialist in the expedition descending through the Descent. He can heal and use wood magic to close pathways.
characters.name: Lucas

characters.description: A healer and one of two known survivors of the missing expedition. She is unconscious but recovering after infected tissue was removed from a corrupted wound.
characters.name: Jonah

characters.description: A Valakun hunter known as a very high-level healer and wind mage.
characters.name: Salthar

characters.description: A birdlike lightning being whose speed and homing attacks force Ilea to escape its territory rather than continue fighting.
characters.name: Young lightning elemental

characters.description: An ancient telepathic captive sustained by mana in a deep Descent facility. It tells Ilea that captors used its blood as the basis of the spreading corruption and asks her to rescue an infected Fae.
characters.name: Ancient mind mage

characters.description: A small Fae found badly corrupted in an ancient laboratory. Ilea contains the corruption while continuing to remove infected tissue and heal the damage.
characters.name: Fae

characters.description: A vast lava being imprisoned in a testing facility after its manipulation-agent trial failed, leaving it uncorrupted. Ilea and the Fae seek its help against a spreading corrupted sand elemental.
characters.name: Four-mark magma creature

characters.description: A steel-bodied four-mark mage that arrives through an ancient transportation platform. It identifies itself as one of the Ascended and attacks Ilea as an intruder with steel, space, void, and blood magic.
characters.name: Ascended
